draft_elevation.note: RECONSTRUCTED by the draft rules, family row 'Second Empire' overlaid with the frontage row: The Pullman house, the register's 'brownstone main block, mansard/dormers/cresting, Prairie portico': the Second Empire family's mansard over the 3B stone body, the entrance central on the Prairie front. The east wing's conservatory bay is the K13 record already standing (pullman_house_1729_prairie_conservatory, T-2306), and the porte-cochere, 1892 east addition, stable and glasshouses are T-1880, T-1881 and T-1934's. The draft keeps that record's footprint out of the traced fabric (`keep_out`), so the wing is drawn once; the sheet's two-storey building at the wing's east end (lettered GARAGE, a 1911 use) stands at two storeys (`wing_storeys`), not the house's three. Heights are the rules' starting values inside RECONSTRUCTION-RULES.md's ranges; bays, entrance side, chimneys and dormers are counts the family rules choose, and the seed 3054461091 only tints the fabric inside +-6 %.
